title: Praise the Father
lyrics_original: Oh sovereign God, Oh matchless King
The saints adore, the angels sing
And fall before the throne of grace
To You belongs the highest praise
These sufferings, this passing tide
Under Your wings I will abide
And every enemy shall flee
You are my hope and victory
Praise the Father, praise the Son
Praise the Spirit, Three in One
Clothed in power and in grace
The name above all other names
To the valley, for my soul
Thy great descent has made me whole
Your word my heart has welcomed home
Now peace like water ever flows
So praise the Father, praise the Son
Praise the Spirit, Three in One
Clothed in power and in grace
The name above all other names
Oh, praise the Father, praise the Son
Praise the Spirit, Three in One
Clothed in power and in grace
The name above all other names
Yours is the kingdom
Yours is the power
Yours is the glory
Forever (Repeat)
Praise the Father, praise the Son
Praise the Spirit, Three in One
Clothed in power and in grace
The name above all other names
The name above all other names

bible_verses.telugu: ప్రభువా, మా దేవా, నీవు సమస్తమును సృష్టించితివి; నీ చిత్తమునుబట్టి అవి యుండెను; దానిని బట్టియే సృష్టింపబడెను గనుక నీవే మహిమ ఘనత ప్రభావములు పొంద నర్హుడవని చె
bible_verses.english: You are worthy, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for you created all things, and by your will they were created and have their being.

bible_verses.telugu: ఆయన తన రెక్కలతో నిన్ను కప్పును ఆయన రెక్కల క్రింద నీకు ఆశ్రయము కలుగును ఆయన సత్యము, కేడెమును డాలునై యున్నది.
bible_verses.english: He will cover you with his feathers, and under his wings you will find refuge; his faithfulness will be your shield and rampart.

bible_verses.telugu: గనుక మనము కనికరింపబడి సమయోచితమైన సహాయముకొరకు కృప పొందునట్లు ధైర్యముతో కృపాసనమునొద్దకు చేరుదము.
bible_verses.english: Let us then approach God’s throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, sovereign Lord and King, I come before Your throne of grace today with a heart full of praise. When suffering and hardship feel overwhelming, hide me safely under the shadow of Your wings. Remind my soul that You are my ultimate hope and victory over every fear. May my life bring honor to You, Almighty God—Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Heavenly Father, sovereign Lord and King, I come before Your throne of grace today with a heart full of praise. devotional.reflection_english: In the middle of life's passing tides and trials, we are invited to lift our eyes to the sovereign King who reigns in glory. Surrounded by the song of angels and saints, we can draw near to His throne of grace with complete confidence. No matter what battles we face today, His wings offer us a safe sanctuary, and His presence secures our ultimate victory. Let your heart rest in the faithful love of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit as you offer Him your highest praise.
